steps.name: Leaving Glaston…
steps.objective: Turn in the quest to [Silvia] in 「Glaston Central Plaza」.

steps.name: A Road That No Longer Exists
steps.objective:
1. Talk to [Silvia] in 「Glaston Central Plaza」, then enter the portal to 「Oscar Road」.
2. Turn in the quest to [Mandarava] in the scenario dungeon 「Misty Oscar Road」.

lines.text: (As the adventurer and Leticia come down from the northern street toward the plaza, a large group of soldiers appears.)

lines.speaker: 레티시아
lines.text: %s, hold on a second. We can't just knock down every soldier...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: ...How do we get through here...?

lines.speaker: 레티시아
lines.text: %s, do you know the way to Oscar Road?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I thought you knew, Letty.

lines.speaker: 레티시아
lines.text: I know it exists, but I don't know where it is.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What do we do...? First, we need to get out of here...
(While the pair hide behind a building, a girl with long red hair appears before them.)

lines.speaker: 실비아
lines.text: Over there, Letty and %s. Shh.

lines.speaker: 레티시아
lines.text: Oh! It's Silvia, slacking off.

lines.speaker: 실비아
lines.text: Letty, I told you that's not what I'm doing. You like taking breaks from work too, so what's your problem?

lines.speaker: 레티시아
lines.text: Then are you here to arrest %s?

lines.speaker: 실비아
lines.text: Even if I tried, I doubt I could. But this situation... Doesn't it seem strange?

lines.speaker: 실비아
lines.text: The soldiers are after %s for plotting to murder Her Majesty... You'd never do that.

lines.speaker: 레티시아
lines.text: That's true. But why are you normal, Silvia?

lines.speaker: 실비아
lines.text: I'm always normal... Letty, what do you mean?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Sorry, Silvia. It's a long story...

lines.speaker: 레티시아
lines.text: We need to get to Oscar Road.

lines.speaker: 실비아
lines.text: ...It can't be...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Silvia, do you know something?

lines.speaker: 실비아
lines.text: Follow me. I'll explain when we get there.
(Fortunately, or perhaps not, the soldiers and knights in the plaza head elsewhere.)
(Keeping watch, the adventurer and Leticia follow Silvia and stop before a building near the siren statue.)

lines.speaker: 실비아
lines.text: Wait a moment.

lines.speaker: 레티시아
lines.text: There's no one around.

lines.speaker: 실비아
lines.text: Good. Just a moment...
(Silvia goes behind the building to check something, then reaches out and beckons them closer.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Silvia, what's there?

lines.speaker: 실비아
lines.text: There's a path to Oscar Road behind here.

lines.speaker: 레티시아
lines.text: A path to the highway?

lines.speaker: 실비아
lines.text: Shh. Keep your voice down, Letty.

lines.speaker: 레티시아
lines.text: All right.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Is there a reason the path has to be hidden?

lines.speaker: 실비아
lines.text: They say Oscar Road was a garden treasured by the first emperor. It must have been beautiful for him to turn an area the size of a village into a garden.

lines.speaker: 실비아
lines.text: I read that it's full of mysterious relics, with a beautiful lake nearby and rare flowers and trees.

lines.speaker: 실비아
lines.text: They say that during the reign of Emperor Isnel XIV, demons killed so many people there that entry was forbidden.

lines.speaker: 실비아
lines.text: I don't know if that's why, but now only a few people know about it.

lines.speaker: 실비아
lines.text: People stopped going there and even feared it, so they built this building to block the path.

lines.speaker: 레티시아
lines.text: Wow, I had no idea.

lines.speaker: 실비아
lines.text: Since then, the plaza caretaker apparently goes out to patrol and clean it. Apart from that, no one visits the highway...

lines.speaker: 실비아
lines.text: That's my part done. To think what Her Majesty told me would lead to this...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What did she tell you?

lines.speaker: 실비아
lines.text: Ten years ago... Kaina—no, Her Majesty—came to speak to me before she took the throne.

lines.speaker: 실비아
lines.text: I was just excited to meet the beautiful princess. But I still remember that moment, so it must have left quite an impression.

lines.speaker: 실비아
lines.text: She called it her first vision and asked me a favor.

lines.speaker: 실비아
lines.text: She said she didn't know when, but someone helping her would be in danger in Glaston, and I should show them the way to Oscar Road.

lines.speaker: 실비아
lines.text: She also said the Council's soldiers would pursue them, and Argent would buy them time... I never imagined it would be like this.

lines.speaker: 실비아
lines.text: Anyway, be careful. I think I should hide where my brother told me to.

lines.speaker: 실비아
lines.text: I don't know how this will end. I just hope everyone will be safe.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Thank you, Silvia.

lines.speaker: 실비아
lines.text: I'll go, then. Take care, Letty.

lines.speaker: 레티시아
lines.text: Yep, I'll be back. It's my mission, so I'll do it right.
(After checking that no one is nearby, Silvia hurries toward LaChouette Street.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: ...I hope nothing happens to her...

lines.speaker: 레티시아
lines.text: Silvia will be fine. The commander is here. Nothing will happen to her.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: That's true, but...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: All right. Let's head to the highway.

lines.speaker: 레티시아
lines.text: Yep!
(Following the path Silvia showed them, the pair see enormous stone monuments embedded in the hillside.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Is this where Oscar Road starts...? How far do we need to go...?

lines.speaker: 레티시아
lines.text: Let's keep going for now. Look, there's a lake over there.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: The lake Silvia mentioned...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I didn't know there was a place like this near Glaston.

lines.speaker: 레티시아
lines.text: I've never had a reason to come this way either.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: There seems to be a path over there...
(Not knowing how far to go, the pair hurry toward the lake. A thick fog rises before them.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Ugh, what...? All of a sudden...
(The fog thickens until it fills everything in sight, as though gathering the scattered darkness.)

lines.speaker: 레티시아
lines.text: I've heard mist often forms near lakes, but this is ridiculous.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (This isn't ordinary fog. Someone must have made it.)

lines.speaker: 레티시아
lines.text: %s, follow me. This is the way.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Letty? Oh, you found your way through the Magic Administration Building too.

lines.speaker: 레티시아
lines.text: Leave the navigation to me. Oh, %s.

lines.speaker: 레티시아
lines.text: There's something ahead. Something round is floating there, but I don't think it's the Spirit King.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Wait a moment.
(The adventurer reaches out, and their hand slips inward as though being sucked into something.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Uh, huh? Oh!
Y-you! What are you? Did you just touch me?

steps.name: Misty Road
steps.objective:
1. Talk to [Mandarava] in 「Misty Oscar Road」, then take the portal to the dungeon's next area and gather an <Oscar Herb Flower>.
2. After leaving the dungeon, defeat [Flying Wood Mimic] on 「Oscar Road」, then turn in the quest to [Mandarava] on 「Oscar Road」.

lines.text: Pop.
(With a cheerful pop like an uncorked glass bottle, %s's arm slips free from wherever it had gone.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Wh-what?
(While the adventurer is still bewildered, something flies toward them at high speed.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (T-too late...)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Uh...
(Instead of the hard object they expected, a surprisingly soft bundle of cotton hits their face.)

lines.speaker: 레티시아
lines.text: %s, this is sooo soft.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Soft?
(Recovering, the adventurer pulls the thing off their face and stares at it.)
You let go of this. You mustn't treat me carelessly. You let go. Now!
(A weed-shaped doll struggles as though alive.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Oh, this is...

lines.speaker: 레티시아
lines.text: Whoa, the doll's alive!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What are you? A doll Circe made?
(The struggling doll freezes for a moment.)
Circe? I'm not a doll made by that wicked witch. I'm not!

lines.speaker: 레티시아
lines.text: %s, I think it's angry. And it knows a witch!
I am a doll, but I'm an herb spirit. An herb bag made by a good witch. And stop poking me!
(Leticia pokes the doll that calls itself an herb spirit, then grins.)

lines.speaker: 레티시아
lines.text: Sorry. It's just so strange. This is only the second time I've seen a spirit like this.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Hmm... So, herb spirit... I can think of you as a spirit living in an herb bag?
That's right, that's right. I'm the spirit Mandarava.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What were you doing here?

lines.speaker: 만다라바
lines.text: Playing on Oscar Road. No, working. Then I met you two humans.

lines.speaker: 레티시아
lines.text: There you have it, %s. Let's go.

lines.speaker: 만다라바
lines.text: I-I'm not finished talking. Not finished!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Sorry, Mandarava. We have to go. We don't have time for this...

lines.speaker: 만다라바
lines.text: This is important. So you two listen to my important story. Listen!

lines.speaker: 만다라바
lines.text: You won't get there even if you walk all day.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: There...? You knew I was coming?

lines.speaker: 만다라바
lines.text: I checked whether you were someone who could go there. I'm a spirit entrusted with such important work. Ahem.

lines.speaker: 만다라바
lines.text: If you just go, you'll keep circling the same place in the fog. So listen to me.

lines.speaker: 레티시아
lines.text: %s, wait a moment.
(Leticia runs straight ahead. A little later, she reappears behind the adventurer.)

lines.speaker: 레티시아
lines.text: You were behind me just now, and now you're in front... Hmph.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: So that's what you meant.

lines.speaker: 만다라바
lines.text: What suspicious humans. You can get out if you do as I say.
(Mandarava shakes itself, opening its zipper. A small flower falls out.)

lines.speaker: 만다라바
lines.text: Bring me lots of Oscar Herb Flowers right away. They look like this. You can gather them here.

lines.speaker: 레티시아
lines.text: %s, we've got nothing to lose. Shall we try?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Mandarava. If we do that, we really can get out?

lines.speaker: 만다라바
lines.text: Spirits don't lie. Has everyone you've met deceived you?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I've met a lying spirit before. And yes, I was fooled.

lines.speaker: 만다라바
lines.text: Th-that spirit was bad. I'm not bad.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: All right. I'll trust you for now.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Letty, I'll gather them up ahead. Please search behind us.

lines.speaker: 레티시아
lines.text: Yep, got it.

lines.speaker: 레티시아
lines.text: %s, the fog is gone!

lines.speaker: 만다라바
lines.text: Wow!

lines.speaker: 만다라바
lines.text: Wow! Wow! You found all the herb flowers in the fog. I can finally get out! I can!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: You can finally get out? Were you trapped?

lines.speaker: 만다라바
lines.text: Even monkeys fall from trees sometimes.

lines.speaker: 레티시아
lines.text: But you're a spirit, Mandarava.

lines.speaker: 만다라바
lines.text: Even herb spirits can fail to find herbs. This was a space you could only leave after finding the herbs, but suddenly fog appeared and I couldn't see them. I was in trouble.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Did you make this fog?

lines.speaker: 만다라바
lines.text: Herb spirits don't make things like that. I don't know how, either. Anyway, thank you. Thank you.

lines.speaker: 만다라바
lines.text: I'll be going now. You should go too.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Wait, I have a question.
(With that, Mandarava floats into the air and drifts away on a gentle breeze like a balloon.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What a self-centered spirit.

lines.speaker: 레티시아
lines.text: It's all right.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Letty?

lines.speaker: 레티시아
lines.text: Hehe, I used telekinesis to tie a thread to its zipper. It's flying slowly, so we can follow the thread.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Well done, Letty. Let's follow it.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (...This place is strange. There seem to be animals and monsters that don't belong here...)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Let's not worry about that for now...)

steps.name: Glinda the Witch
steps.objective: Talk to [Mandarava] on 「Oscar Road」, then defeat [Elusive Boss] and [Trumpet Munchkin]. Turn in the quest to [Runo] in 「Dorothy Village」.

lines.speaker: 만다라바
lines.text: I am the perfect herb spirit that no one can stop. But I'm caught on a branch.
(Mandarava struggles, caught in a beautifully glowing tree.)

lines.speaker: 만다라바
lines.text: Who tied this thread to me? Aaagh, if I keep struggling, my fabric will tear. It can't keep tearing...

lines.speaker: 만다라바
lines.text: Oscar Road has nothing but monsters. It's dangerous. Is anyone there? Someone save me! Save this herb spirit!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Phew. I'll save you.
(Seeing the adventurer and Leticia, Mandarava waves happily.)

lines.speaker: 만다라바
lines.text: Come here at once. Cut the thread quickly. Do the good deed of helping me.

lines.speaker: 레티시아
lines.text: You really have a way of making people not want to save you.

lines.speaker: 만다라바
lines.text: You talk strangely too. What's with that? What's with that?
(The adventurer reaches up to hold Mandarava while Leticia cuts the thread with telekinesis.)

lines.speaker: 만다라바
lines.text: The little human's technique is good. Very good.

lines.speaker: 레티시아
lines.text: Thanks for the compliment. You know what? I'm the one who tied this thread.

lines.speaker: 만다라바
lines.text: ...This is why I hate little kids... Did I mention someone was coming to meet you?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Meet us? Oh, what's that?
(An eerie light flows between the trees where Mandarava was caught.)
(Through the light, a path leads toward an enormous, ruined-looking castle.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: An emerald castle...

lines.speaker: 레티시아
lines.text: A castle? What castle? You can see the imperial palace from here, but it's white.
(As the adventurer starts forward, drawn by something, a voice rings out.)
Stop there.
(The speaker places a hand on her scabbard, and a great flash of light spreads around them.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Ugh, so bright...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What? What happened?
(The path to the emerald castle, visible just a moment ago, is gone.)
Are you %s?
(A woman with long, flowing black hair approaches and takes her hand off her scabbard. She opens a hand fan and fans %s, who is breaking into a cold sweat.)
I cut away the ominous power flowing through the highway. Don't worry.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What do you mean? No, first, who... are you? How do you know me...?
Someone Iris and many others have asked to keep you safe.
(The woman closes her fan and smiles faintly.)

lines.speaker: 글린다
lines.text: My name is Glinda. I'm an elf from Ljosalf, and a witch burdened with a troublesome fate.

lines.speaker: 글린다
lines.text: If Iris sent you, you know that not every witch pursues [Night], don't you? For now...

lines.speaker: 글린다
lines.text: This isn't the place to talk. We'll discuss the details in the village.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes, understood.

lines.speaker: 레티시아
lines.text: Wow, wow. I've never met a witch before.

lines.speaker: 글린다
lines.text: %s, who is this child beside you? Iris didn't mention anyone else coming...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: She's a knight who helped me. Circumstances brought us here together.

lines.speaker: 레티시아
lines.text: I promise I'll never tell anyone I met a witch. Please trust me.

lines.speaker: 글린다
lines.text: Such confidence. Then I will take that as a promise.

lines.speaker: 글린다
lines.text: If you break your word and speak carelessly, whoever hears it will be in danger too.

lines.speaker: 레티시아
lines.text: Is it a witch's curse or something?

lines.speaker: 글린다
lines.text: Think what you like.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Lady Glinda, wait. Leticia...

lines.speaker: 글린다
lines.text: %s, this is not your decision. It is hers.

lines.speaker: 레티시아
lines.text: %s, I'm fine. I just have to do as she says.

lines.speaker: 글린다
lines.text: Child, tell me your name.

lines.speaker: 레티시아
lines.text: I'm Leticia.
(Glinda nods quietly and taps Leticia's shoulder with her fan.)

lines.speaker: 글린다
lines.text: That is all.

lines.speaker: 레티시아
lines.text: Thank you, Lady Witch.

lines.speaker: 글린다
lines.text: Then I grant you entry to the village.

lines.speaker: 글린다
lines.text: There's no need to worry so much. Just don't cause trouble.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Thank you, Lady Glinda.

lines.speaker: 레티시아
lines.text: Hehe, nice to meet you, Lady Witch.

lines.speaker: 글린다
lines.text: Is that how human children talk these days? It grows on you after a while.

lines.speaker: 글린다
lines.text: Oh, Mandarava. Tell me what happened and why you were late.

lines.speaker: 만다라바
lines.text: Glinda, listen. I wasn't playing. I went to gather herb flowers and meet these people, but fog suddenly appeared and trapped me.

lines.speaker: 만다라바
lines.text: Fog never appears on Oscar Road. Never. There wasn't any even during the Twilight... This person gathered the herb flowers, and the fog went away. Phew.

lines.speaker: 글린다
lines.text: Fog... It can't be...

lines.speaker: 글린다
lines.text: You two, follow me. We shouldn't stay on the highway for long.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (It seemed like Lady Glinda stopped herself from saying something... But what's that sound? Is someone playing an instrument...?)

lines.speaker: 글린다
lines.text: %s, what are you waiting for?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I suddenly heard sad music from somewhere...

lines.speaker: 글린다
lines.text: What sound? Cough, cough. You're imagining it. Come on, or I'll leave you behind.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (...Did I hear it wrong? I can't hear anything now...)

lines.speaker: 글린다
lines.text: More importantly, why are the Munchkin beastfolk, mimics, and cooking spirits outside? I'll have to take them back on the way. Cough, cough.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Hmm...
(After the group follows Glinda away, emerald light flows between the trees once more.)
(From one side of the emerald castle glowing in the faint fog, a woman stares at the place they left.)
Glinda...
You're pretending not to hear the music I play for you...

steps.name: A Visit to Dorothy Village
steps.objective: Talk to [Runo] in 「Dorothy Village」, then greet [Binah] followed by [Elliot]. Then turn in the quest to [Glinda].

lines.text: (As they follow Glinda along the highway, the scenery changes in an instant.)
(Just moments ago they were on the highway overlooking the lake. Now they stand in a village on an island within it.)

lines.speaker: 레티시아
lines.text: Huh? Wow... Lady Witch, wh-what is this place?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: So this is Dorothy Village.
(Cute buildings shaped like animals and the charming atmosphere capture the adventurer's and Leticia's attention.)

lines.speaker: 글린다
lines.text: The village is named after a witch who fought demons long ago. So we would not forget her.

lines.speaker: 글린다
lines.text: We discovered this place while cutting down the demons pursuing us. A strange island in the middle of the lake.

lines.speaker: 글린다
lines.text: Dorothy said it could be a place only we knew, hidden from all other beings...

lines.speaker: 글린다
lines.text: After Dorothy died in an accident, I settled here to pray for her soul.

lines.speaker: 글린다
lines.text: Eventually, people burdened with unhappy fates began to arrive. Seeing how unwelcome they were everywhere else, I couldn't turn them away.

lines.speaker: 글린다
lines.text: That was how the Dorothy Village you see today began.

lines.speaker: 글린다
lines.text: Dorothy would have wanted it too. She always wished that those with unhappy fates could find even a little happiness.

lines.speaker: 글린다
lines.text: As the village's host, let me greet you again. Welcome to Dorothy Village.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Thank you for welcoming us.

lines.speaker: 레티시아
lines.text: It's so pretty, like a village in a fairy tale.

lines.speaker: 글린다
lines.text: Really? I wouldn't know...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: When we looked at the lake from the highway, there wasn't an island...

lines.speaker: 글린다
lines.text: You probably know a similar village on another continent. Hidden from outside, cut off from the world...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Kali Village?)

lines.speaker: 글린다
lines.text: When you leave, go straight back that way. It will look as though you're walking into the lake, but keep going without thinking. You'll find yourself on the highway.
Boss, you're back. Is this the person you mentioned...?

lines.speaker: 글린다
lines.text: %s, say hello. This is Runo. Runo, this is %s.
(A deer beastman in sturdy armor regards the group with a cold gaze.)

lines.speaker: 루노
lines.text: I'm Runo, the village guard. From what the boss said, I thought you were coming alone...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Circumstances left us no choice but to come together.

lines.speaker: 글린다
lines.text: Runo, I've allowed this child, Letty, to stay in the village.

lines.speaker: 루노
lines.text: Is that so? Understood, Boss.

lines.speaker: 레티시아
lines.text: I'm Leticia. You can call me Letty.

lines.speaker: 루노
lines.text: You aren't surprised to see a beastman.

lines.speaker: 레티시아
lines.text: I once met a beastperson by chance, and they were just a person. There wasn't a single reason to be surprised.

lines.speaker: 루노
lines.text: No reason to be surprised...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (I suppose Letty doesn't have any prejudices.)

lines.speaker: 글린다
lines.text: It's that time already. Runo, have a meal and rest for the day.

lines.speaker: 루노
lines.text: I was going to patrol the highway... But if you say so, Boss, I'll rest.

lines.speaker: 글린다
lines.text: I'm afraid you'll go out and play instead of working, like Mandarava.

lines.speaker: 만다라바
lines.text: Glinda, are you saying I'm that kind of spirit? No, no. I've played a lot before, but I was never late. This was the only time.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: So you were playing anyway...

lines.speaker: 글린다
lines.text: %s, see the stuffing coming out of Mandarava's side?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes. What about it?

lines.speaker: 글린다
lines.text: It seems to get grumpy when too much falls out.

lines.speaker: 글린다
lines.text: Come on, Mandarava. Let's go to Binah. She'll replace it with new stuffing.

lines.speaker: 만다라바
lines.text: Oh, new stuffing. New stuffing! Put in new stuffing and let's jump. Hop, hop. My head will reach the garden.

lines.speaker: 글린다
lines.text: Talking to Mandarava is surprisingly tiring. Binah really is the best person for it.

lines.speaker: 글린다
lines.text: The house where you'll stay is at the far end. Keep following me.

lines.speaker: 루노
lines.text: Then I'll see you later, Boss.
(As they follow Glinda into Dorothy Village, Leticia cannot stop exclaiming in amazement.)

lines.speaker: 레티시아
lines.text: Wow. The village is so beautiful I don't know where to look.

lines.speaker: 레티시아
lines.text: Wow! Wooow! The animal-shaped houses are pretty, and even the little chick walking by is pretty.

lines.speaker: 레티시아
lines.text: That cat is pretty too!
Meow?
(Someone in the direction Leticia points perks up her ears, then approaches Glinda with a bright smile.)
Mom, I was basking in the sun.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Mom?)

lines.speaker: 글린다
lines.text: Binah, there you are.
(Glinda gently embraces and strokes the cat beastgirl she calls Binah.)

lines.speaker: 글린다
lines.text: You're warm. You must have just woken from a nap here.

lines.speaker: 비나
lines.text: Hehe. I did what you told me, Mom.

lines.speaker: 레티시아
lines.text: Wow, Lady Witch, who's this? She's so pretty!

lines.speaker: 글린다
lines.text: %s, this is my adopted daughter, Binah.

lines.speaker: 글린다
lines.text: Binah, this is %s.
Um... Glinda...

lines.speaker: 비나
lines.text: Meow. Then you're the one traveling for the goddess, right?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: That's right.

lines.speaker: 비나
lines.text: Nice to meet you. I'm Binah.

lines.speaker: 글린다
lines.text: And this is Leticia, who came with %s.

lines.speaker: 레티시아
lines.text: I'm Leticia. You can call me Letty.

lines.speaker: 비나
lines.text: %s and Letty. I've remembered your names. How long will you two be staying?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I'm not sure, exactly.

lines.speaker: 비나
lines.text: Meow. Then let's get along while you're here.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Thank you.

lines.speaker: 레티시아
lines.text: Hehe. Cute things are always wonderful.

lines.speaker: 글린다
lines.text: That's enough introductions. Binah.

lines.speaker: 비나
lines.text: Yes, Mom.

lines.speaker: 글린다
lines.text: Please put fresh stuffing in Mandarava. It's coming out, and I think that's why it's grumpy.

lines.speaker: 비나
lines.text: Meow. Mandarava, I only just changed your stuffing. Go into the Munchkin Warehouse and find some new stuffing, and I'll put it in.

lines.speaker: 만다라바
lines.text: Binah is too mean to me. Too mean.

lines.speaker: 비나
lines.text: Why?

lines.speaker: 만다라바
lines.text: I don't like the warehouse because it's such a mess. You don't go in because you don't want to get lost, and you always send me.

lines.speaker: 비나
lines.text: Spirits are good at finding their way.

lines.speaker: 만다라바
lines.text: That's true.

lines.speaker: 비나
lines.text: Don't you want new stuffing?

lines.speaker: 만다라바
lines.text: I like stuffing. I'm going into the warehouse, so stay here and wait. Wait.
(Mandarava floats over to a teapot-shaped building and knocks. Soon, the door opens and a little cat paw pulls it inside.)

lines.speaker: 글린다
lines.text: Mandarava is fine in every other way, but so stubborn.

lines.speaker: 비나
lines.text: It's a spirit.

lines.speaker: 글린다
lines.text: It's hard for anyone to truly understand spirits. Even me. Anyway, Binah, is your practice going well?
Glinda...

lines.speaker: 비나
lines.text: I've been practicing hard with the baton you made me, Mom.

lines.speaker: 글린다
lines.text: Well done. Just keep it up. Binah, I'll take these two along now.

lines.speaker: 비나
lines.text: Meow. I'll fill Mandarava with stuffing, then practice a little more. See you two later.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Good luck with your practice, Binah.

lines.speaker: 레티시아
lines.text: Wow, Binah's cute and hardworking. Hehe, see you later.
Um...
(Feeling a sudden tug on their clothes, the adventurer looks around and meets the eyes of someone who looks anxious.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Who are you?

lines.speaker: 글린다
lines.text: %s, who are you talking to? Elliot?
(The person called Elliot looks as though he might cry at any moment.)

lines.speaker: 엘리엇
lines.text: Glinda... I called you several times...

lines.speaker: 글린다
lines.text: Sorry. Your voice was so quiet I didn't hear you.

lines.speaker: 엘리엇
lines.text: I'm sorry... I-is this loud enough?

lines.speaker: 글린다
lines.text: Better than before, but still quiet.

lines.speaker: 엘리엇
lines.text: Is it? I'll... try... a little harder.

lines.speaker: 글린다
lines.text: Is something wrong?

lines.speaker: 엘리엇
lines.text: No... nothing's wrong... I saw we had guests and wanted to say hello...

lines.speaker: 글린다
lines.text: Good. Then I'll introduce you. Elliot, this is %s. %s, this is Elliot. He listens to the villagers' troubles.

lines.speaker: 엘리엇
lines.text: H... hello. I'm... Elliot.

lines.speaker: 글린다
lines.text: Elliot is staying here because of his own circumstances. It's been two years already, hasn't it?

lines.speaker: 엘리엇
lines.text: Yes...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Nice to meet you. I'm %s...

lines.speaker: 엘리엇
lines.text: %s...? I feel like I've heard that name somewhere...

lines.speaker: 글린다
lines.text: A fairly famous person. Ask for details later.

lines.speaker: 엘리엇
lines.text: Yes...
(Elliot looks downcast, then turns to Leticia.)

lines.speaker: 레티시아
lines.text: Hello. I'm Leticia. You can call me Letty. So, big sister Elliot...

lines.speaker: 글린다
lines.text: Letty, Elliot is a boy.

lines.speaker: 레티시아
lines.text: Huh? Really? A big brother, then, not a sister.

lines.speaker: 글린다
lines.text: How old are you, Letty?

lines.speaker: 레티시아
lines.text: Eighteen.

lines.speaker: 글린다
lines.text: Then you're the older one.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Elliot, are you all right? You look pale.

lines.speaker: 엘리엇
lines.text: Ah...

lines.speaker: 엘리엇
lines.text: I-I'm fine. I'm timid, so... sudden attention makes me a little anxious...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Shouldn't you go inside and rest?

lines.speaker: 엘리엇
lines.text: Thank you... for your concern. I'm doing my best... so I'm fine. You don't need to worry...

lines.speaker: 레티시아
lines.text: Elliot, where do you live?

lines.speaker: 엘리엇
lines.text: Over there...

lines.speaker: 레티시아
lines.text: %s, Lady Witch. I'll take Elliot home.

lines.speaker: 글린다
lines.text: Would you?

lines.speaker: 레티시아
lines.text: Leave it to me.

lines.speaker: 엘리엇
lines.text: I-I'm... fine. I still have things to do outside...
(Before Elliot can finish, Leticia takes him away.)

lines.speaker: 글린다
lines.text: That child certainly makes the village more interesting.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Is Elliot all right?

lines.speaker: 글린다
lines.text: If he says he's all right, he probably is for now. Though I can't know how he feels inside...

lines.speaker: 글린다
lines.text: You do it too. Everyone says they're all right in front of others. It's how they keep going.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Do you do that too, Lady Glinda?

lines.speaker: 글린다
lines.text: Well... I don't particularly feel like answering that right now.

lines.speaker: 글린다
lines.text: Iris must care for you deeply. She said she didn't know whether you'd need to leave Dorothy Village, but if you did, I should help you...

lines.speaker: 글린다
lines.text: This will help.
(Glinda places a round white object in %s's hand.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What is it?

lines.speaker: 글린다
lines.text: Pretty, isn't it? It's a Moon-Gazing Rabbit Snow Globe I made...

lines.speaker: 글린다
lines.text: The power within it will keep almost anyone from recognizing you. It should let you travel outside the village.

lines.speaker: 글린다
lines.text: If you want someone you know to recognize you, say your name. Then they'll see you properly.

lines.speaker: 글린다
lines.text: It lasts a few days, so it should be enough while you're staying here.

lines.speaker: 글린다
lines.text: Don't go to Glaston. That demon's power might stop it from working. I'll give you a few extra, so keep them with you.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Thank you, Lady Glinda.

lines.speaker: 글린다
lines.text: Well... never mind.

lines.speaker: 글린다
lines.text: Here we are. The building over there is where you and Leticia will stay.

steps.name: A Suspicious Atmosphere
steps.objective:
1. Talk to [Glinda] in 「Dorothy Village」, then complete both side quests (The Warehouse's Secret) and (Elixir of the Heart).
2. Review the situation in front of the village monument, then turn in the quest to [Mandarava] on 「Oscar Road」.

lines.speaker: 글린다
lines.text: %s, you seem to be resting well. Time flies, doesn't it?

lines.speaker: 글린다
lines.text: Has it already been a week since you arrived?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It really has, Lady Glinda. Time went faster than I expected. Have you been busy? I feel like I haven't seen you in days...

lines.speaker: 글린다
lines.text: It's nothing you need to worry about, but I've had a lot to do. Anyway, I prepared two private rooms so you could rest comfortably. How are they?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I can count on one hand the times I've slept this well since I began my journey. Thanks to your care, I've rested comfortably.

lines.speaker: 글린다
lines.text: I don't know when you'll leave, but enjoy your stay until then. You have nothing else to do in this village.

lines.speaker: 글린다
lines.text: Where's Letty?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Still asleep.

lines.speaker: 글린다
lines.text: She's getting a good rest. Hm?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What is it? Oh...
(The sound of an instrument drifts on the wind and lingers in %s's ears.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (It's that lonely melody from the highway... I've heard that large string instrument for days now.)
(Soon, noisy wind instruments join the lonely melody and fill the village.)

lines.speaker: 글린다
lines.text: Noisy, isn't it? Cough, cough.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What?

lines.speaker: 글린다
lines.text: That trumpet over there.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Are they playing together?

lines.speaker: 글린다
lines.text: The Munchkin tribe is practicing first thing in the morning again.
(Glinda frowns slightly and looks toward the teapot-shaped building.)

lines.speaker: 글린다
lines.text: I should warn you. It'll be very noisy while you're here.

lines.speaker: 글린다
lines.text: The Munchkin tribe used to live in a tiny little village in the Creed region.

lines.speaker: 글린다
lines.text: But they came here after a wicked witch attacked and destroyed their village.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: If they're from Creed, are they beastfolk?

lines.speaker: 글린다
lines.text: Cat beastfolk, much smaller than Binah. But their presence is unmistakable. They're musically gifted. Watching them play together is astonishing.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Now that you've said that, I'd like to hear them properly someday.

lines.speaker: 글린다
lines.text: Binah is practicing conducting too, though I don't know when they'll play together.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I'm looking forward to the concert. Oh, may I ask about the explanation you promised?

lines.speaker: 글린다
lines.text: Oh, sorry. I said I'd explain once we reached the village... I'm very late.

lines.speaker: 글린다
lines.text: Three or four years ago... As you know, a huge wall blocking the Jiendia continent disappeared.

lines.speaker: 글린다
lines.text: I had some idea of what was happening, but I thought it had nothing to do with me...

lines.speaker: 글린다
lines.text: Then outsiders began finding our village, and their numbers grew. Each time, I erased their memories and sent them back, or cut them down if they seemed dangerous.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: ...What kind of dangerous people?

lines.speaker: 글린다
lines.text: Witches trying to kill the witches here, bounty hunters on witch hunts, and mages who kidnapped beastfolk.

lines.speaker: 글린다
lines.text: Their identities don't matter to me. If they endanger us, I cut them down.

lines.speaker: 글린다
lines.text: But that alone won't protect the village. So I decided to find another way.

lines.speaker: 글린다
lines.text: I combined my knowledge with the information I'd gathered and tried many things, but nothing worked. Then I learned one thing...

lines.speaker: 글린다
lines.text: That gap in time...? Iris calls it the wall. I thought of interfering with it.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Wait. You didn't...

lines.speaker: 글린다
lines.text: Don't worry. If I'd touched it, I'd already be dead. Even a witch like me couldn't do that.

lines.speaker: 글린다
lines.text: At the time, I was desperate to do anything for the village. So I went searching through Seres Temple without a plan.

lines.speaker: 글린다
lines.text: And I found Iris collapsed nearby.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: ...Near Seres Temple...

lines.speaker: 글린다
lines.text: Yes... I considered passing her by, but I couldn't do it. I carried her back to the village.

lines.speaker: 글린다
lines.text: Looking back, it was the right choice. A Demigod named Belosh and several battle priests were at the temple then.

lines.speaker: 글린다
lines.text: Witches were dying at Belosh's hands simply because the Order had declared them heretics.

lines.speaker: 글린다
lines.text: Without even checking whether they were guilty, he called it the will of the gods...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: So Belosh did that.

lines.speaker: 글린다
lines.text: You know him.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (I briefly describe facing Belosh in Vanitas.)

lines.speaker: 글린다
lines.text: What an interesting way for our connections to intertwine...

lines.speaker: 글린다
lines.text: Anyway, I brought Iris here and waited for her to wake, but she didn't. Instead, something strange happened.

lines.speaker: 글린다
lines.text: Our village could no longer be seen from outside. Exactly as I'd wanted... And all I'd done was care for the sleeping Iris...

lines.speaker: 글린다
lines.text: A few days later, in a dream, I think... A beautiful blonde woman appeared and said she was Seres.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Lady Seres?

lines.speaker: 글린다
lines.text: Yes. Seres, the God of the Astral Realm before Iris. She said that if I left Iris before the temple, she would soon awaken inside.

lines.speaker: 글린다
lines.text: Just then, I heard the Demigod and battle priests were leaving for somewhere else. I went straight to the temple and left Iris in front of it.

lines.speaker: 글린다
lines.text: After a while, young priests found Iris and, startled, carried her inside. They said the oracle had been right...

lines.speaker: 글린다
lines.text: Later, after Iris became the God of the Astral Realm, she sent me her thanks. She said she'd seen me bring her to the village in a dream.

lines.speaker: 글린다
lines.text: After that, I protected a few people here at Iris's request. The village was safer under a god's protection, too.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: May I ask whom you protected?

lines.speaker: 글린다
lines.text: Hilda and Lepica stayed here. Hilda left when she heard you were coming. Lepica followed, saying it would be safer together, even though Hilda objected.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Hilda...

lines.speaker: 글린다
lines.text: I don't know the details, but it seems Hilda won't be coming back. Am I right?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes...
(Through the trumpet-filled music, the ominous melody approaches again.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (I keep hearing that music from the highway... Am I the only one who hears it?)

lines.speaker: 글린다
lines.text: It's noisy, but bear with it a little longer. They'll finish soon. If it's too much, go inside your lodging. It should be quiet there.

lines.speaker: 글린다
lines.text: Cough... cough...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Lady Glinda, are you all right?

lines.speaker: 글린다
lines.text: I'm fine. It's just a little cough. Anyway, as I said, I'd like you to rest here without doing anything.
(Glinda gazes intently at %s's face.)

lines.speaker: 글린다
lines.text: You're the type who can't sit still, aren't you?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I feel more comfortable doing something.

lines.speaker: 글린다
lines.text: I recommend resting, but if you insist, look around the village for work. There should be a small task or two.

lines.speaker: 글린다
lines.text: Just make sure you don't put Dorothy Village in danger.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Don't worry.

lines.speaker: 글린다
lines.text: All right. I have work to do, so I'll take my leave...
(After the conversation, Glinda heads off into the village.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: If Hilda and Lepica were here too, Iris clearly knows Dorothy Village and Lady Glinda well...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: But Lady Glinda seems to be hiding something...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (I'll look around the village and see what I can find out...)
(Trying to ignore the lonely melody, the adventurer leaves. Glinda watches them go, then quietly turns her gaze toward the highway.)

lines.speaker: 글린다
lines.text: Cough, cough.
(As though by prior agreement, the people and spirits in the village scatter out of sight.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (It's suddenly quiet... Shall I rest a little and sort out my thoughts?)
(%s's gaze naturally turns toward the enormous stone monument standing like a ruin in the center of Dorothy Village.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (I only wanted to learn what Lady Glinda was hiding, but things have become more complicated.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Everyone tells me not to get involved... But now that I know, I don't think I can back away. Let's put it all together.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Starting with the dragonkin, Tip and Tipeta, appearing in the village...)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (How did they find their way in?)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (You need Lady Glinda's permission to enter Dorothy Village.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (If she'd allowed them in, she wouldn't have reacted like that...)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Let's think of something else...)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (They didn't seem to have been here before. They were looking around the village...)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (If they had, they would have acted on their real purpose first. They wouldn't have bothered making themselves invisible.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Let's think of something else...)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (If someone helped those two dragonkin enter the village, it would have to be someone who can manage a place like this, as Lady Glinda does...)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Someone with that much power... A witch, perhaps? Then targeting Lady Glinda would make sense.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Not pursuing Night doesn't mean she can't be a target.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Then that witch must be nearby...)
(%s looks toward Oscar Road beyond the lakeshore.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Lady Glinda was clearly in a hurry where we first met. What was she trying to hide...?)
(Just then, the music from before comes from Oscar Road. Shifting key, it grows more passionate and grates on the listener's ears.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (It sounds like that music is being sent here deliberately. I should investigate. Hm?)
(%s sees Glinda heading out of the village.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Lady Glinda is going outside too... All right, I'll follow her.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Thinking hard always makes me hungry.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (I have the snack the Elusive Boss gave me. I'll eat some of that.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Oh, what an unusual flavor. What is it? Well, now that I've eaten, let's think this through from the beginning.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (How did they find their way in?)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (You need Lady Glinda's permission to enter Dorothy Village.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (If she'd allowed them in, she wouldn't have reacted like that...)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Let's think of something else...)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (They didn't seem to have been here before. They were looking around the village...)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (If they had, they would have acted on their real purpose first. They wouldn't have bothered making themselves invisible.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Let's think of something else...)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (If someone helped the two dragonkin enter the village, they must be able to manage this sort of place, like Lady Glinda.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Someone with that much power... A witch, perhaps? Then targeting Lady Glinda would make sense.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Not pursuing Night doesn't mean other witches won't target her.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Then that witch must be nearby...)

steps.name: A Painful, Sorrowful Melody
steps.objective:
1. Talk to [Mandarava] on 「Oscar Road」, then enter the area with the fountain.
2. Listen to the story about the musical performance in front of the fountain, then return to [Mandarava] on 「Oscar Road」 and turn in the quest.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Mandarava, have you seen Lady Glinda?

lines.speaker: 만다라바
lines.text: Glinda? I haven't seen Glinda. I didn't hear she was coming.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Then where did she go?

lines.speaker: 만다라바
lines.text: What happened? What's going on?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Lady Glinda heard the music and came outside. Right now, only she and I can hear it...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Mandarava?

lines.speaker: 만다라바
lines.text: Huh? Oh...
(As Mandarava floats around, %s catches it in both hands.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Can you hear that sound?

lines.speaker: 만다라바
lines.text: Spirits hear well even without ears. I don't know which sound you mean. Birds, wind, music? Tell me which.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: You heard that music, didn't you? Why have you been pretending not to?

lines.speaker: 만다라바
lines.text: I never pretended. You didn't ask, so I didn't answer. Glinda doesn't like talking about Dorothy.

lines.speaker: 만다라바
lines.text: Oops...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Dorothy? I heard she died in an accident... Wait, does that mean she's the one playing?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Mandarava, you know something, don't you? Strange people came to the village after that music started.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: They said they were dragonkin, descendants of the Black Dragon.

lines.speaker: 만다라바
lines.text: Oh, it can't be... Glinda may not like it, but I have no choice. I'll tell you... Though I'm not certain.

lines.speaker: 만다라바
lines.text: ...Did Dorothy not die? From her music, it feels like she wants to see Glinda...

lines.speaker: 만다라바
lines.text: That's just how it feels. I don't know the details. Dorothy disappeared back then, and everyone thought she was dead...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What on earth happened?

lines.speaker: 만다라바
lines.text: The music is getting sadder. I think fog is rolling into the highway again.

lines.speaker: 만다라바
lines.text: Oh, was the music causing the fog?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Can you tell where on the highway the music comes from? I've searched several times, but I can't find the player.

lines.speaker: 만다라바
lines.text: There's a tightly shut gate in the middle of the highway. If you go inside, you might find Dorothy...

lines.speaker: 만다라바
lines.text: But I don't know whether Glinda is there...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Oh, that gate...

lines.speaker: 만다라바
lines.text: I'll wait here. If I see Glinda, I'll tell her you've gone there.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: All right...

lines.speaker: 만다라바
lines.text: %s... Glinda is a little ill. Don't let her stay there too long.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Understood. I'll go there now.
(After the adventurer leaves, emerald light spills from above where Mandarava stands.)

lines.speaker: 만다라바
lines.text: I knew the seal had weakened... We can't leave it like this...
(The gate looks sealed shut, but gently gives way the moment the adventurer touches it.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Uh...
(Beyond it are only an apparently unused fountain and a chair. Nothing else is in sight.)
(Yet the lonely music calling to the adventurer continues without pause.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I don't know who you are. But I think you're playing this music because you have something to say.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Why don't you show yourself now?
(At the adventurer's words, the lonely music gradually slows. Then the bow slips across the strings, filling the space with a piercing sound.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Ugh... It feels like I'm being stabbed all over...)
This wasn't meant for you... Go back...
(A woman's voice gives a lonely warning from the far end of the otherwise empty space.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I can hear it too. So I need to know.
Go back... I said go back... I... I only need to see Glinda... Just go back!!
(As the voice grows irritated, the bow slips again and a sharp sound pierces %s.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Ugh!
I don't want to hurt you... But if you insist on interfering...
(The music resumes, and the wind-driven ripples on the lake stop moving.)
(Leaves caught on the pillars and fountain freeze in the breeze. Startled, the adventurer steps back, only to be stopped by an invisible wall.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Did she make a barrier to keep me from leaving?)
(As the adventurer looks around, the unseen speaker slowly emerges from behind the fountain.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (An enormous cello...)
(An elf woman with long blonde hair and a pale green veil places a large string instrument before her and gazes into the distance.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Wait... Her eyes are covered with bandages. How can she play?)
You're wondering how I can play like this... Don't concern yourself with it.
I won't stop playing until you stop breathing. I already warned you...
(With her warning, the music grows more passionate and tightens around the trapped %s's throat.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Gh... S-stop...
(The adventurer raises their weapon and swings toward the voice, but strikes no one.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (I'm losing consciousness... At this rate...)
(At that moment, a great flash bursts into %s's vision.)
(Like a glittering star breaking apart, light falls in fragments, and the frozen things slowly begin to move.)
(The lake ripples again, leaves stir in the breeze, and the pain constricting the adventurer's throat disappears.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Hah, hah... Hah...
(Someone in a red robe slowly walks past %s.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Lady Glinda...?
(The blonde elf tries to resume playing, but hesitates when Glinda speaks a name.)

lines.speaker: 글린다
lines.text: Dorothy...?
...Don't call me that! You called me that however you pleased, then killed me!!
I am Dorothea. Dorothea!!

lines.speaker: 글린다
lines.text: Dorothy... You've misunderstood. It's a misunderstanding. Listen to me. Back then...
(As the woman calling herself Dorothea begins playing again, darkness floods the surrounding scenery.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Wh-what?)

lines.speaker: 글린다
lines.text: Dorothy... Stop. Don't do this here. Please... This place is precious to us. Those red shoes I bought you... You're still wearing them...
(Glinda reaches toward Dorothea, then suddenly recoils in surprise.)

lines.speaker: 글린다
lines.text: Dorothy?

lines.speaker: 글린다
lines.text: Don't! You mustn't draw power from the gap in the Great Wall!!
(Glinda puts her hand on her scabbard, and another flash erupts. Through the fractured light, a new scene appears.)
(The fountain that was filled with vines and flowers is now flowing with water.)

lines.speaker: 도로테아
lines.text: Glinda... Glinda, Glinda!!!!!!!!
(Dorothea tries to resume playing in anger, but her movement suddenly stops.)

lines.speaker: 도로테아
lines.text: Now you've broken my bow too?

lines.speaker: 글린다
lines.text: Dorothy, listen to me. Back then, you and I...

lines.speaker: 도로테아
lines.text: I don't want to hear your voice anymore... Glinda.
(As Dorothea turns away, black fog rushes in.)

lines.speaker: 글린다
lines.text: Black fog?!

lines.speaker: 글린다
lines.text: %s, close your eyes! Now!!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What? All right!

lines.speaker: 도로테아
lines.text: Glinda, it's no use. I know you don't have much time left. I'll return soon and stop what little time remains with my music.

lines.speaker: 도로테아
lines.text: Just as you stopped my life that day. Before the emerald castle...
(After a span of silence with no sound or presence, %s's eyes naturally open.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: No one's here... Where did they go?
(As %s looks around, water overflowing from the fountain pools before them.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: She clearly said it was power drawn from the gap in the Great Wall...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Iris...)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Where did Lady Glinda go? I need to find her...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Should I ask Mandarava? Binah said it knows everything on the highway...)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Let's hurry...

steps.name: Glinda's Condition
steps.objective: Talk to [Mandarava] on 「Oscar Road」, then take <Lepica's Potion Bottle>, which [Mandarava] gave you, to the [Fountain] and complete the quest there.

lines.text: (Seeing %s approach, Mandarava becomes furious.)

lines.speaker: 만다라바
lines.text: What did I tell you? Glinda, Glinda is sick! I told you not to let her stay there long. I told you!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Where is Lady Glinda?

lines.speaker: 만다라바
lines.text: She said she was going in after Dorothy. When I stopped her, she collapsed right there...

lines.speaker: 만다라바
lines.text: I buried her somewhere with strong herbal energy... No, laid her down... She kept trying to get up, but I finally convinced her to sleep.

lines.speaker: 만다라바
lines.text: That witch Glinda is so stubborn. If I hadn't, she'd have gone into Emeraldia and died.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Mandarava, tell me now. What happened to Lady Glinda? You know everything.

lines.speaker: 만다라바
lines.text: Even if I know, it's not my story to tell. I can't. Oh, Glinda, why are you getting up? Lie down a little longer.

lines.speaker: 글린다
lines.text: I can't. Cough, cough. If I stay here, everyone will be in danger... Cough, cough.
(Glinda coughs, then spits blood.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Lady Glinda!!

lines.speaker: 만다라바
lines.text: Glinda! Have you considered that acting like this could put everyone in danger? Have you?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Lady Glinda, stop being stubborn. You need to take care of yourself first.

lines.speaker: 글린다
lines.text: ...Cough, cough.
(Unable to answer, Glinda sits back against the tree.)

lines.speaker: 만다라바
lines.text: ...Glinda, you really will die if you keep this up.
(Looking at Glinda, Mandarava opens its zipper and drops something out.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: An empty bottle?

lines.speaker: 만다라바
lines.text: This isn't just any bottle. It's an empty potion bottle Lepica gave me to use wherever it was needed.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Still an empty bottle...

lines.speaker: 만다라바
lines.text: Stop talking and throw this bottle into the fountain. Once it's full, take it out and bring it back.

lines.speaker: 만다라바
lines.text: Glinda needs that water. It will help her recover a little.

lines.speaker: 만다라바
lines.text: It has a special power. Once she drinks it, she should be able to tell you something.

lines.speaker: 만다라바
lines.text: It probably won't happen, but if you lose Lepica's potion bottle, tell me again. I can give you as many as you need.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Oh, that's how it works? All right. I'll be right back.

lines.speaker: 만다라바
lines.text: I'm counting on you, %s. Oh, and don't forget to close the lid.

steps.name: At the Awakened Fountain
steps.objective: Use the Gather skill at the fountain on 「Oscar Road」 to obtain <Spring Water of Memory>. Then turn in the quest to [Mandarava] on 「Oscar Road」.

lines.text: (Following Mandarava's instructions, I throw Lepica's potion bottle into the fountain.)
(Soon, the empty bottle fills with water. When the adventurer closes the lid, the clear water begins to sparkle and glow.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It's beautiful. It feels like it's filled with light... Oh, this isn't the time for that.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Let's return to Mandarava.

steps.name: Dreamlike Emeraldia
steps.objective:
1. Have the conversation on 「Oscar Road」, then enter 「Emeraldia」.
2. Defeat [Dorothea] in 「Emeraldia」 and obtain the <Handkerchief of Sacrifice>. Then return to [Mandarava] on 「Oscar Road」 and turn in the quest.

lines.speaker: 만다라바
lines.text: Good work.
(Mandarava opens the potion bottle received from %s and hands it to Glinda.)

lines.speaker: 만다라바
lines.text: Here, Glinda. Drink.

lines.speaker: 만다라바
lines.text: If you don't want to die like this, drink. If you die now, Dorothy, changed as she is, will take your power. You know that, don't you?

lines.speaker: 만다라바
lines.text: Then the Dorothy Village you want so badly to protect could disappear.

lines.speaker: 만다라바
lines.text: Think about the others too. Never mind the adults—what about Binah...?

lines.speaker: 글린다
lines.text: Binah...
(Repeating Binah's name under her breath, Glinda seems to reach a decision and nods.)

lines.speaker: 글린다
lines.text: All right, Mandarava. Cough, cough.
(Suppressing her cough, Glinda laboriously wipes the blood from her mouth.)

lines.speaker: 글린다
lines.text: I never wanted to drink this, even at death's door...
(Glinda squeezes her eyes shut and drinks the water in the potion bottle.)

lines.speaker: 글린다
lines.text: Phew...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Are you all right now?

lines.speaker: 글린다
lines.text: For now. But if the music starts again, I don't know what will happen...

lines.speaker: 만다라바
lines.text: The Spring Water of Memory is usually just water, but for some, it's good medicine. It's filled with the wish of someone who sacrificed herself and asked to be remembered.

lines.speaker: 글린다
lines.text: Mandarava, how much do you know? I only met you ten years ago... That was something Dorothy did long ago...

lines.speaker: 만다라바
lines.text: Don't ask too much. You know I'm a spirit!

lines.speaker: 글린다
lines.text: Yes... All right.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Lady Glinda... May I hear your story?
(Glinda quietly nods.)

lines.speaker: 글린다
lines.text: When was it...?
(Glinda closes her eyes and searches through her memories.)

lines.speaker: 글린다
lines.text: For a long time after the Sky of Chaos ended, the continent was bustling with reconstruction.

lines.speaker: 글린다
lines.text: The Ljosalf and Dokkalf of Alfheim joined in rebuilding the continent, dreaming of a new future.

lines.speaker: 글린다
lines.text: But reports began to spread of beings called witches appearing across the continent and hurting people.

lines.speaker: 글린다
lines.text: There was a girl living in that era. Like Binah, she was full of dreams and laughter. She believed those stories had nothing to do with her.

lines.speaker: 글린다
lines.text: Then, one day, she knew. Instinctively, she felt her fate had become different from everyone else's.

lines.speaker: 글린다
lines.text: She'd wanted to live an ordinary life among ordinary elves...

lines.speaker: 글린다
lines.text: One day, Night suddenly began. An unknown witch took the girl's hand, saying that if she wanted something, she should pursue Night.

lines.speaker: 글린다
lines.text: I don't remember where it was, but women from all over had gathered there.

lines.speaker: 글린다
lines.text: One girl caught her eye: a blonde elf with beautiful eyes. Saying she'd never met anyone from Ljosalf before, she drew the girl over. That was Dorothy.

lines.speaker: 글린다
lines.text: Their conversation was brief, but it became a precious memory. Two elf girls who wanted ordinary lives could share their feelings about suddenly becoming witches...

lines.speaker: 글린다
lines.text: They talked about childhood habits and favorite things. Then, while Dorothy played the cello she'd brought... it happened.

lines.speaker: 글린다
lines.text: Someone's voice rang through the entire space. Along with pain that tormented the ears came the voice's sorrow and rage...

lines.speaker: 글린다
lines.text: That was part of Walpurgis Night.

lines.speaker: 글린다
lines.text: One witch went mad from the voice and began to rampage. Other witches fell to the ground, bleeding...

lines.speaker: 글린다
lines.text: The two girls, who still didn't understand a witch's fate, could only flee in terror. And, unfortunately, the girl discovered her own power and that of another.

lines.speaker: 글린다
lines.text: Honestly... Ah... As if being chased by other witches weren't tiresome enough, witch hunts began all over the continent.

lines.speaker: 글린다
lines.text: Witches died, but innocent people were caught up and killed too. After watching people who helped us die, we stopped running.

lines.speaker: 글린다
lines.text: We didn't want to live day after day fated to die at someone else's hands...

lines.speaker: 글린다
lines.text: So the girl and Dorothy decided to become strong enough to protect each other. Once they had, they chose a new path.

lines.speaker: 글린다
lines.text: That is the story of that girl—of Dorothy and me. For now, that is enough.

lines.speaker: 글린다
lines.text: As for the castle, anything beyond what I experienced myself may not be true.

lines.speaker: 글린다
lines.text: Across the path between those trees is not the Etoile we know. It's another world. Think of somewhere like the Demon Realm.

lines.speaker: 글린다
lines.text: Emeraldia first appeared in our world during the Twilight.

lines.speaker: 글린다
lines.text: In a world abandoned by the gods, a path resembling a connection to the Demon Realm appeared, and all living beings trembled in fear.

lines.speaker: 글린다
lines.text: Brave souls gathered to explore Emeraldia and met the castle's master, Oz the Black Dragon.

lines.speaker: 글린다
lines.text: Oz said he always devoured the worlds connected to Emeraldia. Hoping Etoile would be another delicious meal, he swallowed the heroes.

lines.speaker: 글린다
lines.text: But the heroes cut open Oz's belly and escaped. Clutching his torn stomach, the wicked dragon vanished with Emeraldia. We thought it would never appear again...

lines.speaker: 글린다
lines.text: Was it around the year 840? Dorothy and I were pursuing our own work while avoiding witches and those who hunted them.

lines.speaker: 글린다
lines.text: We traveled around completely destroying the Demon Realm gates that appeared in Etoile, and sealing those we couldn't destroy as securely as possible.

lines.speaker: 글린다
lines.text: Then we heard a troubling rumor. Children were disappearing in Glaston and other regions.

lines.speaker: 글린다
lines.text: That was when we found Emeraldia. Many children had followed the light spilling from it into the castle...

lines.speaker: 글린다
lines.text: And those who came to their senses and refused to enter were seized by dragonkin and dragged inside.

lines.speaker: 글린다
lines.text: Many knights and soldiers went in to rescue them... Most were swallowed by Oz. Even those who returned alive did not return sane...

lines.speaker: 글린다
lines.text: We hurried to Oscar Road to seal Emeraldia's entrance...

lines.speaker: 글린다
lines.text: But our usual methods and the power we had were nowhere near enough. While I agonized over it, Dorothy seemed to make up her mind...

lines.speaker: 글린다
lines.text: She told me to use my power. Can you believe it? To use my power, 'Encroachment,' to speak to her mind and make her a sacrifice for the seal...

lines.speaker: 글린다
lines.text: I refused and said we should find another way. But while we hesitated, more and more people were dragged away and killed.

lines.speaker: 글린다
lines.text: When I kept hesitating, Dorothy said she couldn't wait any longer and tried to kill me. Whoever died, the other would gain enough power to seal Emeraldia...

lines.speaker: 글린다
lines.text: I was supposed to protect Dorothy... But when she took my sword and held it to her throat, I broke.

lines.speaker: 글린다
lines.text: At that moment, I felt I had no other choice...

lines.speaker: 글린다
lines.text: Dorothy's magic and witch's power exploded, and Oz fell. I cut off his horns and head so he could never rise again. I thought that was the end...

lines.speaker: 글린다
lines.text: Then Dorothy's mind returned, and I thought I could save her...

lines.speaker: 글린다
lines.text: At that moment, Oz's soul rose and lunged at me.

lines.speaker: 글린다
lines.text: Dorothy saw it and pushed me outside. Suddenly, sharp thorny vines wrapped around her face and body, wounding her everywhere. Her eyes were probably injured then...

lines.speaker: 글린다
lines.text: When the thorns covered her so completely that I could no longer approach, Emeraldia vanished before my eyes...

lines.speaker: 글린다
lines.text: That was the last I saw of Emeraldia and Dorothy...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: So you built the village near Oscar Road...

lines.speaker: 글린다
lines.text: Even though she'd vanished, I believed she wasn't dead. So I kept waiting.

lines.speaker: 글린다
lines.text: If Dorothy had died... If I'd killed her, her power would have passed to me.

lines.speaker: 글린다
lines.text: Since it hadn't, I waited all this time. I thought I'd see her again someday...

lines.speaker: 글린다
lines.text: How foolish of me. Seeing her again would mean Emeraldia had returned too.
(After finishing her long story, Glinda somehow looks relieved.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It isn't foolish...

lines.speaker: 글린다
lines.text: Thank you... Then I'll continue. For a long time afterward, I cut away every ominous presence here to keep Emeraldia from returning...

lines.speaker: 글린다
lines.text: But I left an opening through which Dorothy could return... That was my mistake. The dragonkin came through it.

lines.speaker: 글린다
lines.text: If this continues, everyone will be in danger... The barrier hiding the village won't hold much longer...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: We can do this. We have to protect everyone. I'll help.
(Glinda quietly looks into %s's eyes.)

lines.speaker: 글린다
lines.text: I really can't figure you out. You could simply pass by without a word...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Now that I know, I can't just walk away.

lines.speaker: 글린다
lines.text: Sometimes you seem like Iris, and sometimes you don't... Hehe.
(Just then, the music that had been silent for a while begins again, and Glinda writhes in pain.)

lines.speaker: 글린다
lines.text: Cough, cough. Cough, cough. Dorothy, please... Stop. Please...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Lady Glinda!! Are you all right?!

lines.speaker: 글린다
lines.text: So this is the music you prepared for me, Dorothy...
(Glinda forces a smile, then loses consciousness and collapses.)
(Mandarava supports her and props her against the stone monument behind them.)

lines.speaker: 만다라바
lines.text: From what you've said, Dorothea seems to have misunderstood a great deal. Otherwise, she wouldn't play with the intention of killing Glinda...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (I don't think this will end just by meeting Dorothea... I'll probably face those dragonkin from the village again too...)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Oh, wait... Lady Glinda said Dorothea mustn't use the gap in the Great Wall...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I don't fully understand the situation, but it will affect Iris too...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Mandarava, I'll go into the castle.

lines.speaker: 만다라바
lines.text: I'm sorry this herb spirit can't be more helpful...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It's all right. I'm going because this may be something I have to do. Please look after Lady Glinda while I'm gone.

lines.speaker: 만다라바
lines.text: Understood. Then prepare properly before you go.

lines.speaker: 만다라바
lines.text: Oh... Already gone...

lines.speaker: 만다라바
lines.text: Dorothea, Glinda...
(Following the path between two trees filled with emerald light, the adventurer sees the scenery change in an instant.)
(The castle that was only faintly visible comes into view. The blue lake that filled their sight moments ago is nowhere to be seen.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: So this is Emeraldia...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (These seem to be the castle walls. How long are they? I can't see the end. And why are there so many spires...? Ruined buildings float in the sky, like in the Void Sea...)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Where is Dorothea? That's...
(%s looks around, then fixes their gaze on a distant spire.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: The dragonkin...
(The adventurer steps back and raises their weapon. Tip, who was leaning against the spire, jumps down in front of them. Tipeta spreads her wings and flies over too.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Tip and Tipeta...

lines.speaker: 티페타
lines.text: Oh, dear hero. You remembered my name. I didn't expect to see you again like this. You came to see me, didn't you? I'm so happy.

lines.speaker: 팁
lines.text: How can you say that when a hero cut open your belly and killed you?

lines.speaker: 티페타
lines.text: Hehe, what does it matter? That was when Oz was alive.

lines.speaker: 팁
lines.text: Sigh. My sibling has inherited all of Oz's bad tastes.

lines.speaker: 티페타
lines.text: Quiet, Tip. You inherited his stupidity.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (What on earth are they talking about?)

lines.speaker: 팁
lines.text: Tipeta, that's enough. We should get ready to welcome our guest, shouldn't we?

lines.speaker: 티페타
lines.text: Yes, you're right. We have our own work to do.
(Tipeta smiles brightly at the adventurer.)

lines.speaker: 티페타
lines.text: Welcome to Emeraldia, dear hero.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Why do you keep calling me a hero?

lines.speaker: 티페타
lines.text: Do you really not know? A hero fights for justice and to save the world. That's what I understand a hero to be. Hehe.

lines.speaker: 티페타
lines.text: You shouted it while cutting open Oz's belly and pulling out his horns. 'If you appear in Etoile again, we'll do the same thing!' Such threats.

lines.speaker: 티페타
lines.text: But what now? Just like Oz back then, we've appeared in Etoile again.
(The moment Tipeta finishes, Tip raises his sword and lunges at %s.)
(Though briefly startled, the adventurer calmly parries Tip's attack, then dodges Tipeta's mace swinging before their face.)

lines.speaker: 팁
lines.text: Oho. This is more interesting than before. Shall we keep going?

lines.speaker: 티페타
lines.text: Tip, let's not do this here. There's no need to waste our strength. Dorothea's piece will be finished soon. Let's wait until then.

lines.speaker: 팁
lines.text: It was just getting fun... Well, if we must.

lines.speaker: 티페타
lines.text: Tip, can I tell our hero about that? We're going to kill them anyway, so it doesn't matter.

lines.speaker: 팁
lines.text: Do as you like.

lines.speaker: 티페타
lines.text: Dear hero, we'll become Oz again and destroy everything you love. We'll be reborn as the wicked dragon that will devour Etoile.

lines.speaker: 티페타
lines.text: Dorothea's piece will be complete very soon.

lines.speaker: 티페타
lines.text: A beautiful piece that will lead Glinda into torment and turn us back into Oz.

lines.speaker: 티페타
lines.text: When she plays her cello with a bow made from the melted horns of a high-ranking demon, Dorothea's soul will disappear happily too.

lines.speaker: 티페타
lines.text: I do feel a little bad about that. We tormented her so much. We held on to her soul, which wouldn't vanish even after her body died, and made her curse Glinda.

lines.speaker: 티페타
lines.text: We told her Glinda killed her! That she abandoned her for her own sense of justice!!

lines.speaker: 티페타
lines.text: Knowing nothing, poor Dorothea's soul wrote a piece to kill the Glinda she had loved.

lines.speaker: 티페타
lines.text: And we added a way to bring Oz back to life. Oh, thinking that it's nearly finished makes my heart race.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: How can you say that so casually...?

lines.speaker: 팁
lines.text: Lux said he'd take care of you in Glaston. Apparently that didn't go well. Our moment has come too soon.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Lux again...)
(Just then, a beautiful melody echoes from somewhere in Emeraldia.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (This is Dorothy's...)

lines.speaker: 티페타
lines.text: Tip, let's go. It won't be long now. There's no need to fight our hero here.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Stop right there.

lines.speaker: 팁
lines.text: We've waited so long for this. Do you think we'll just say 'yes' and stop because you ask?

lines.speaker: 팁
lines.text: Tipeta, I've changed my mind. That human, before we become Oz...

lines.speaker: 티페타
lines.text: Our hero will die anyway, so let's deal with them first. This place doesn't inspire me. Let's wait along the way and finish them there.

lines.speaker: 팁
lines.text: Let's cut loose for the first time in ages.
(Tipeta grabs Tip's wrist and beats her wings. Rising into the air, she sneers at the adventurer.)

lines.speaker: 티페타
lines.text: Dear hero, don't interfere with the completion of Dorothea's masterpiece, 「Dreamlike Emeraldia」. Don't go inserting an intermission wherever you please.
(With that, Tipeta flies toward the sad music, carrying Tip.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Dreamlike Emeraldia... It suits Dorothea's music, but to think all of this was planned so long ago...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: This is all Lux's...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I can't stand by. I have to stop this performance myself.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Let's hurry...
(The melody, steeped in hurt, sorrow, and suffering, grows ever more passionate.)
(Remnants that have absorbed Emeraldia's surging emotions chase the adventurer, but all fall soon afterward.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Hah, hah... Why are there so many? Fighting Tip and Tipeta along the way was hard enough...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (The music is getting louder. Am I nearly there?)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (The music stopped...)
(As the adventurer rounds the alley ahead, Dorothea stands there, staring blankly at Emeraldia's sky.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Dorothea...

lines.speaker: 도로테아
lines.text: Please go back. This music isn't for you. If you leave now, nothing will happen to you.

lines.speaker: 도로테아
lines.text: A little more playing, and Dreamlike Emeraldia will be complete.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Dorothea, what do you want?

lines.speaker: 도로테아
lines.text: Glinda's death... That's all I need.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: If Lady Glinda dies, the people, places, and world you loved will all fall apart.

lines.speaker: 도로테아
lines.text: My life already fell apart the moment Glinda pointed her sword at me.

lines.speaker: 도로테아
lines.text: Glinda pushed me into the thorns to save herself. In that moment, I went blind in agony!!

lines.speaker: 도로테아
lines.text: How dare you say that when you can see these bandages covering my face?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Dorothea, listen carefully. Those are false memories. Tip and Tipeta, the two dragonkin, deceived you.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: The dragonkin used you to resurrect Oz. They held your soul captive and made you hate Glinda.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Dorothea, you have to stop here.

lines.speaker: 도로테아
lines.text: Tip? Tipeta? Who are they? Resurrect Lord Oz, the master of this castle?

lines.speaker: 도로테아
lines.text: Lord Oz... Lord Oz is the one who saved me when I was dying. It makes no sense to say he died and will be resurrected.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Dorothea, Lady Glinda still misses you.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: She couldn't forget you, so she built a village named after you near Oscar Road and has lived there ever since.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Do you still think she killed you? She's the one who gave you those red shoes you're wearing.

lines.speaker: 도로테아
lines.text: Red shoes?

lines.speaker: 도로테아
lines.text: Glinda...
(As Dorothea speaks, something seems wrong. She clutches her head with both hands.)

lines.speaker: 도로테아
lines.text: I was struck by Glinda's sword... No, I touched Glinda's sword... Then she was angry and...

lines.speaker: 도로테아
lines.text: Pushed me into the thorns? Glinda would never do that. Me... me...

lines.speaker: 도로테아
lines.text: We'd been together for so long... We were trying to defeat the wicked dragon Oz and seal the path...

lines.speaker: 도로테아
lines.text: ...Which memories are mine...?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (She's confused...)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Dorothea, stay with me. Hm?
(For a moment, Dorothea's body blurs, then returns.)
(The bewildered Dorothea stiffens and stares at the adventurer.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Dorothea?
(At that moment, the air surrounding Dorothea in Emeraldia changes.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Ah...
(The adventurer hurriedly puts distance between them and Dorothea and raises their weapon.)

lines.speaker: 도로테아
lines.text: My piece is nearly complete. No one can stop my performance. I... I am...

lines.speaker: 도로테아
lines.text: Dorothea, the Witch of Dreams...
(Dorothea raises her bow and draws it across the cello strings, cutting off every surrounding sound.)
(Only 「Dreamlike Emeraldia」 echoes, filled with false feelings toward Glinda.)

lines.speaker: 도로테아
lines.text: ...Now just a little, just a little more...
(Dorothea blocks %s's attack, but the impact snaps her bow. She tries to keep playing with the broken bow, yet only a harsh roar emerges.)
(Hearing it, Dorothea stops moving.)

lines.speaker: 도로테아
lines.text: Why am I playing this here? This isn't my music... This isn't me...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Dorothea?
(Tears flow from beneath the bandages covering Dorothea's eyes.)

lines.speaker: 도로테아
lines.text: What have I been doing... all this time...?
(As Dorothea sinks down with her cello, the previously unseen Tipeta and Tip appear above her.)

lines.speaker: 팁
lines.text: What are you doing, Dorothea?! Finish playing! There's hardly any left!!

lines.speaker: 티페타
lines.text: We even prepared a special bow for you. Kill Glinda with your music, and kill that human.

lines.speaker: 도로테아
lines.text: Lord Oz?

lines.speaker: 티페타
lines.text: Dorothea, we... No, I am Oz. The Oz who has cared for you all this time. Come on, keep playing. Then...

lines.speaker: 팁
lines.text: Argh, this is so frustrating. What's so hard about it? Put that thing you're holding against the strings!!
(Unable to stand it any longer, Tip tries to snatch Dorothea's bow, then abruptly freezes.)

lines.speaker: 팁
lines.text: Gah...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Dorothea...?
(Tip clutches the bow embedded in his chest and collapses in agony.)

lines.speaker: 티페타
lines.text: Tip, stay with me!! Tip!!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Dorothea? Have you come to your senses?

lines.speaker: 도로테아
lines.text: I'm sorry. I misunderstood you and Glinda... I realized far too late that something was wrong...

lines.speaker: 도로테아
lines.text: Without knowing, I let those dragonkin deceive me and spent so long trying to connect Emeraldia to Etoile...

lines.speaker: 티페타
lines.text: Tip!! Tip! Tip...?
(Unconscious in Tipeta's arms, Tip slowly crumbles into dust and disappears.)

lines.speaker: 도로테아
lines.text: Tipeta... You thought a bow made from two high-ranking demon horns would complete the performance... But one of those horns was purified by a Demigod.

lines.speaker: 도로테아
lines.text: You didn't even know how the heroes of old fought a wicked dragon that seemed to have no weakness.

lines.speaker: 티페타
lines.text: Don't tell me that was...

lines.speaker: 도로테아
lines.text: In Freios, purified demon horns have long been used to hunt wicked dragons and dragonkin. Oz, who came from another world, wouldn't have known.

lines.speaker: 도로테아
lines.text: Oz, now I remember you properly. Glinda cut off your head and tore out your horns, but your soul still clung to me and refused to let go...

lines.speaker: 티페타
lines.text: And thanks to that, your soul was able to stay here all this time!!

lines.speaker: 도로테아
lines.text: Tipeta, stop now. You won't last much longer either. It will take centuries for you to revive again...

lines.speaker: 티페타
lines.text: Aaaaaagh!!
(Enraged by Dorothea's words, Tipeta screams, and the ominous power gathered in Emeraldia rushes around her.)
(Darkness swallows Emeraldia's light, and the ruined castle walls shake violently.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Dorothea, we have to get out.
(The adventurer reaches out to take Dorothea's hand, but cannot grasp it.)

lines.speaker: 도로테아
lines.text: My body is already dead. Oz has bound only my soul here. Unless you're a remnant of Emeraldia, you cannot touch me.

lines.speaker: 도로테아
lines.text: %s, hurry. This is your only chance to leave Emeraldia. Go that way.

lines.speaker: %s
