lines.text: What will you do, Dorothea?

lines.speaker: 도로테아
lines.text: If you get outside, I'll send a little luck your way.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Dorothea...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: All right. I'll trust you and leave.

lines.speaker: 도로테아
lines.text: Thank you.
(Dorothea listens to %s's footsteps retreating outside, avoiding Tipeta's furious attacks.)
(Then she touches her tear-stained eyes and gazes into empty space.)

lines.speaker: 도로테아
lines.text: To think a witch restored my memories... You need my power of 'Sacrifice,' don't you?

lines.speaker: 도로테아
lines.text: All right. Then promise me one thing. Yes, thank you. I can feel your heart too. Your feelings for someone precious—that alone is enough.
(A new bow appears before Dorothea, as though someone has given it to her.)

lines.speaker: 도로테아
lines.text: Goodbye, Emeraldia. Goodbye, Oz.
(Dorothea settles into position and begins playing again. The lonely melody that once held sorrow, hurt, and pain changes into joy, happiness, and warmth.)

lines.speaker: 티페타
lines.text: Dorothea, no!! Stop!!
(Tipeta, who had been pursuing the adventurer, rushes toward Dorothea. At that moment, Emeraldia's green light turns to shadow and covers everything.)

lines.speaker: 티페타
lines.text: I said stop...

lines.speaker: 티페타
lines.text: Stop...

lines.speaker: 도로테아
lines.text: Oz, I'll awaken from the dream and vanish now. 「Dreamlike Emeraldia」 is for you now, not Glinda.

steps.name: A Gift Left Behind
steps.objective: Talk to [Mandarava] on 「Oscar Road」, then turn in the quest to [Runo] in 「Dorothy Village」.

lines.speaker: 만다라바
lines.text: %s, grab on! Hurry!! Don't say anything, just grab on!!
(Mandarava suddenly appears before %s, who is running toward Oscar Road.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Mandarava?

lines.speaker: 만다라바
lines.text: There's no time!! Emeraldia is d-disappearing!! If we stay here, everyone in this domain will vanish!!
(Mandarava hurriedly pulls thread from its side and wraps it around the adventurer.)

lines.speaker: 만다라바
lines.text: Spirits of the wind, blow! Blow harder!! Blow with a whooooosh!
(A powerful gust blows in from somewhere and sends Mandarava and the adventurer flying in an instant.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Waaaaah! I'm flyiiiing! No, I'm falliiiing!
Softly.
(Coming to their senses, the adventurer finds themself lying on top of Mandarava.)

lines.speaker: 만다라바
lines.text: Are you all right?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Uh, y-yes, I'm fine.

lines.speaker: 만다라바
lines.text: %s, look over there.
(The path to Emeraldia between the trees fades. The emerald castle in the distance crumbles and grows faint as well.)
(Even the beasts pursuing the adventurer stop moving, fade, and disappear.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It's all gone...
(Only the trees where the path once stood remain, swaying in the wind. No trace of Emeraldia is left.)

lines.speaker: 만다라바
lines.text: Then Dorothea really did...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes...

lines.speaker: 만다라바
lines.text: Tell me what happened inside.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: All right. Well...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (I tell Mandarava what happened in Emeraldia.)

lines.speaker: 만다라바
lines.text: It's good that Dorothea came to her senses, but...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Is Lady Glinda all right?
(Glinda still lies unconscious nearby.)

lines.speaker: 만다라바
lines.text: She looks all right now, but she's used so much power to hold back Emeraldia for so long that she could die at any moment...

lines.speaker: 만다라바
lines.text: If we leave her like this, Glinda will surely...

lines.speaker: 만다라바
lines.text: Dorothy!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Dorothy?
(At Mandarava's startled expression, the adventurer turns around. Dorothea has appeared, searching for the fallen Glinda.)

lines.speaker: 도로테아
lines.text: Spirit... It's been a long time. But where is Glinda...?

lines.speaker: 도로테아
lines.text: There's no time... So little of Emeraldia remains that I can't sense Glinda...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Dorothea...
(The adventurer reaches toward Dorothea, but their hand passes straight through her.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Ah...

lines.speaker: 만다라바
lines.text: I can help. Dorothea, over here. Glinda is sleeping for a little while.
(Her body flickering in and out, Dorothea reaches out and takes Mandarava's hand. Then she finds Glinda beside it.)

lines.speaker: 도로테아
lines.text: I'm sorry...
(Mandarava raises Glinda and props her against a nearby rock. Dorothea reaches out to embrace her gently.)
(But Dorothea's spectral hands cannot touch her.)

lines.speaker: 도로테아
lines.text: Glinda, I wanted to see your face... I wanted to feel your warmth...

lines.speaker: 도로테아
lines.text: Back then, it was my own decision. I must have lost my nerve for a moment. I was afraid. Terrified... But I knew it had to be done...

lines.speaker: 도로테아
lines.text: In that moment, Oz found a crack in my soul and drew me into Emeraldia. Without realizing part of my soul had been devoured, I...

lines.speaker: 도로테아
lines.text: I misunderstood you for so long, believing that false dream was the truth...

lines.speaker: 도로테아
lines.text: I'm sorry... I made you suffer for so long... But you'll be all right now. Glinda. I...

lines.speaker: 글린다
lines.text: Dorothy?
(At that moment, Glinda opens her eyes and reaches for Dorothea's face. Her hand passes through the faint figure.)

lines.speaker: 글린다
lines.text: Ah...

lines.speaker: 도로테아
lines.text: I meant to leave before you woke...

lines.speaker: 글린다
lines.text: Leave...? We've only just met again. Where are you going? Dorothy... I'm right here.

lines.speaker: 도로테아
lines.text: I can't stay... Ever since Oz captured me, my soul has been bound to that nightmare.

lines.speaker: 글린다
lines.text: I'll... I'll find some way to put your soul somewhere else...

lines.speaker: 도로테아
lines.text: Don't, Glinda. If you keep doing that, everything I did to face Oz will be for nothing.
(Dorothea smiles softly and gradually fades, as though her colors are washing away.)

lines.speaker: 도로테아
lines.text: The last of Emeraldia's light will soon disappear. Etoile will be a little safer now.

lines.speaker: 도로테아
lines.text: Glinda, now you have to be all right. That's my wish.

lines.speaker: 도로테아
lines.text: Just as you took my hand and led me out of Night, someday I'll take your hand again. Here...
(With those final words, Dorothea disappears from sight.)

lines.speaker: 글린다
lines.text: Dorothy! Dorothy...

lines.speaker: 글린다
lines.text: Dorothy...
(Glinda reaches out to gather the remaining light in her arms, but cannot hold it. Only Dorothea's red shoes remain.)
(Mandarava approaches %s, who has been watching from behind.)

lines.speaker: 만다라바
lines.text: %s, let's return to the village.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What about Lady Glinda?

lines.speaker: 만다라바
lines.text: Glinda won't be ill anymore. Dorothy's power let her life continue. And that power seems to have passed to another witch.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Could it be...

lines.speaker: 만다라바
lines.text: It's a witch's fate...

lines.speaker: 만다라바
lines.text: Let's go now. We need to tell Runo, who's waiting for Glinda...

steps.name: As Though Nothing Happened
steps.objective: Talk to [Runo] in 「Dorothy Village」, then turn in the quest to [Binah] in 「Dorothy Village」.

lines.text: (As soon as they enter the village, Runo runs over and grabs Mandarava.)

lines.speaker: 루노
lines.text: Mandarava, where is the boss?!

lines.speaker: 만다라바
lines.text: Glinda isn't ill anymore. She's all right now.

lines.speaker: 루노
lines.text: R-really...?

lines.speaker: 루노
lines.text: I need to see her right away...

lines.speaker: 만다라바
lines.text: Wait, Runo. Glinda needs time. Just as she gave you time...

lines.speaker: 루노
lines.text: Understood.
(As Runo relaxes his guard, his red eyes return to their original color.)

lines.speaker: 루노
lines.text: %s... I'm sorry. The boss ordered me not to follow.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It's all right. Nothing happened in the village?

lines.speaker: 루노
lines.text: Nothing. I prepared thoroughly in case those dragonkin returned.

lines.speaker: 루노
lines.text: Fortunately, the villagers don't seem to have noticed. Oh, Elliot knew...

lines.speaker: 만다라바
lines.text: Elliot is good at keeping people's troubles confidential, so that's fine.

lines.speaker: 루노
lines.text: He cries a lot, but he's stronger and more admirable than anyone.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What about Letty and Binah?

lines.speaker: 루노
lines.text: They went into the warehouse to explore. How many hours has it been now? The Elusive Boss says they're fine, so I'm keeping watch.

lines.speaker: 루노
lines.text: Are you all right?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I'm fine... Just a little worn out.

lines.speaker: 만다라바
lines.text: You look tired, %s. You should rest. Emeraldia is another world, after all. Visiting alone would be exhausting, and you pushed yourself even further...

lines.speaker: 만다라바
lines.text: Oh!
(Mandarava opens its zipper and takes out an herb. Smiling and wriggling, it seems to be a kind of happy mandrake.)

lines.speaker: 만다라바
lines.text: Wait while I knock it unconscious. Swallowing this has an incredible restorative effect.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It's all right. I'll pass. A little sleep should do...

lines.speaker: 루노
lines.text: All right. Go and rest. Leave the rest to us.

lines.speaker: 만다라바
lines.text: Us?

lines.speaker: 루노
lines.text: You're part of Dorothy Village too.

lines.speaker: 만다라바
lines.text: I'm a spirit, actually...

lines.speaker: 루노
lines.text: Talking to you only tires my mouth. Fine. You go rest too, Mandarava.

lines.speaker: 만다라바
lines.text: Thank you, Runo. I'll sunbathe on the roof and watch for Glinda. %s, go inside and rest.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: All right, Mandarava. See you later too, Runo.
(As soon as the adventurer heads toward the lodging, Mandarava floats up to the roof of a cat-shaped house.)
(But before long, it comes back down to Runo.)

lines.speaker: 루노
lines.text: Why are you down already?

lines.speaker: 만다라바
lines.text: Glinda is coming with a guest. They're coming together.

lines.speaker: 루노
lines.text: A guest? The boss didn't mention one...

steps.name: Daydream
steps.objective: Talk to [Binah] in 「Dorothy Village」, then go to [Glinda]. When all conversations are over, turn in the quest to [Glinda].

lines.speaker: 비나
lines.text: %s!! You're alive?!
(Binah is startled to see %s emerge from the lodging, stretching.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: ...What do you mean?

lines.speaker: 비나
lines.text: Do you know how many days you've been asleep? I mean, do you? Meow? You slept longer than a cat beastperson!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What? I thought it was only a few hours...

lines.speaker: 비나
lines.text: It's been, it's been!! Meow. You've slept for a whole week! I couldn't sleep that long no matter how much I wanted to.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: A whole week...? And no one woke me?

lines.speaker: 비나
lines.text: Letty wondered if you'd died and poked you twice a day, but you just snored and never woke up, so she gave up.

lines.speaker: 비나
lines.text: Mom said to leave you alone, too.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: ...When did Lady Glinda return?

lines.speaker: 비나
lines.text: You mean from seeing her friend? She said it was wonderful to see her after so long.

lines.speaker: 비나
lines.text: Meow-ha. I love seeing Mom smile so happily.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Oh, I see.

lines.speaker: 비나
lines.text: %s, Letty and I are exploring the warehouse again. Want to come? Elliot says he'll go next time. He needs to prepare himself.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I need to see Lady Glinda, so let's go another time. Oh, how did you get out, anyway?

lines.speaker: 비나
lines.text: Bunny Bunny said we were noisy and took us outside. Oh, Bunny Bunny is the one from that ghost story we talked about.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Oh, Bunny Bunny Luceria.

lines.speaker: 비나
lines.text: Hehe, yes. I was trembling in fear, but Letty went right up and kept talking.

lines.speaker: 비나
lines.text: I worked up the courage to talk about Mom, and she seemed interested. When I said I'd tell Mom if she bullied me, she recoiled. It was so cute. Meow.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Ah ha ha. She must really like Glinda...

lines.speaker: 비나
lines.text: It's that time already. Meow-yaaawn. I'm a little sleepy, but I'm fine. See you later, %s. Hehe.
(Binah says goodbye to %s and hurries toward the Munchkin Warehouse.)

lines.speaker: 글린다
lines.text: Binah! Don't stay late exploring the warehouse. Come out early! Understood? And as we agreed, Elliot goes another time!

lines.speaker: 비나
lines.text: Yes, Mom!!

lines.speaker: 글린다
lines.text: Sigh. I don't want to nag, but she's playing with Luceria...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Lady Glinda.

lines.speaker: 글린다
lines.text: Did you sleep well? You showed no sign of waking for a week. I thought you'd died.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Binah said the same thing.

lines.speaker: 글린다
lines.text: Did she? Are you feeling all right? After visiting Emeraldia, it wouldn't have been surprising if you'd collapsed immediately.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I'm fine.

lines.speaker: 글린다
lines.text: I'm glad... Oh, there's something I'd like to discuss. Would you come this way?

lines.speaker: 글린다
lines.text: Thank you.
(Glinda brews tea from fine herbs and sets it before %s.)

lines.speaker: 글린다
lines.text: Thanks to you, I realized how foolish I'd been. I'd bound myself in the name of protecting the village...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I didn't do anything special.

lines.speaker: 글린다
lines.text: No. You're a benefactor to me and our entire village.

lines.speaker: 글린다
lines.text: At first, I thought you were simply a human blessed by Iris. I was wrong. You're far more than that...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I'm glad you're all right.

lines.speaker: 글린다
lines.text: I am. And even if I'm not, I'll make sure I will be. Otherwise Dorothy would be disappointed, wouldn't she? My life continues because of her.

lines.speaker: 글린다
lines.text: %s, I won't live only in hiding anymore.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What? What do you mean...?

lines.speaker: 글린다
lines.text: I don't know about the other witches, but I need to go outside a little. Nothing will change if I stay as I am.

lines.speaker: 글린다
lines.text: Since things have come to this, I'll try defying the fate the Goddess of the Black Moon gave me... That wouldn't be so bad.

lines.speaker: 글린다
lines.text: And I will help you without conditions. After the trust you've shown me, it's only right to repay you.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Lady Glinda, just hearing that is enough to...

lines.speaker: 글린다
lines.text: You helped me awaken from a sorrowful dream covered in darkness. I mean what I say, so accept it.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: All right... I will.

lines.speaker: 글린다
lines.text: %s, what will you do now?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I'll rest in the village and look into Lady Pandora's whereabouts.

lines.speaker: 글린다
lines.text: If Daphne is with her, it won't be easy. Daphne's very way of thinking differs from ordinary people's.

lines.speaker: 글린다
lines.text: Two witches are beside Daphne now: Circe and Pandora. I don't know how she intends to use them...

lines.speaker: 글린다
lines.text: I'll keep looking into it for you. It may take some time. Meanwhile, why not spend it with someone you know?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What? Someone I know? Who?
(At those words, someone taps %s's shoulder with something like a staff.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Oh, this staff...?
(The adventurer turns to see a familiar woman smiling as she lowers her staff.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Lady Medea...?

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: %s, have you been well?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: How did you get here? And those clothes...

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: Shynic heard I had business on another continent, so she joined forces with Lady Io and commissioned an outfit from someone named Crisien. Sigh... I had little choice...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: In Freios?

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: Yes...

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: That's what I'd like to tell you about now. About 'something' Daphne left behind...
